data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-api (ENI AZ-A)
data.notes: Exam/assignment REST API: create & schedule exams, start attempt, 30 s autosave (PUT /api/attempts/{id}/answers), submit, mark, release, presigned upload URLs. One DB connection per instance. A3: connects through RDS Proxy with an IAM token; 3,000-user peak tested at 100 % success, p95 885 ms.

customConfig.reservedConcurrency: unreserved in production (RDS Proxy); 40 on the Free-plan test stack
customConfig.subnetsVariable: lambda_subnet_indexes = [0,1] (set [1] to evacuate a sick AZ, FT3)

data.label: Workers: marking / upload / migrate (ENI AZ-A)
data.notes: marking: auto-marks MCQs from the marking queue + EventBridge auto-submit (max concurrency 20). upload: records submissions from S3 events. migrate: applies schema.sql on deploy.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-api (ENI AZ-B)
data.notes: Same function as AZ-A; Lambda spreads instances over both app subnets, so losing an AZ only removes capacity. A3: connects through RDS Proxy with an IAM token; 3,000-user peak tested at 100 % success, p95 885 ms.

customConfig.reservedConcurrency: unreserved in production (RDS Proxy); 40 on the Free-plan test stack
customConfig.subnetsVariable: lambda_subnet_indexes = [0,1] (set [1] to evacuate a sick AZ, FT3)

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-db PRIMARY (PostgreSQL 16, ap-southeast-1a) db.t4g.medium · exam month db.t4g.large
data.notes: Multi-AZ, synchronous standby in AZ-B. FT1 measured: failover 39 s, RTO 66 s, RPO 0. PITR restore (FT2): RPO 154 s, RTO about 22 min. Only RDS Proxy can connect.

customConfig.note: Free-plan test stack ran db.t4g.micro; production sizing from the load test

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-db STANDBY (synchronous, ap-southeast-1b)
data.notes: Synchronous standby replica. Not readable; promoted automatically if AZ-A or the primary fails. Same DNS endpoint after failover.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-public-rt -> IGW
data.notes: Associated with both public subnets. 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-private-rt-ap-southeast-1a (local only, NO NAT)
data.notes: A3 change C2: no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Only local VPC traffic + S3 prefix list -> S3 gateway endpoint. SQS and Secrets Manager are reached through interface endpoints, so nothing in the private subnets can reach the internet.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-private-rt-ap-southeast-1b (local only, NO NAT)
data.notes: A3 change C2: no 0.0.0.0/0 route. Only local VPC traffic + S3 prefix list -> S3 gateway endpoint. SQS and Secrets Manager are reached through interface endpoints, so nothing in the private subnets can reach the internet.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-waf (AWS WAF, global) 4 rules

rules: RateLimitPerStudent: 1,000 req / 5 min per Authorization token (NEW, load test B1)

data.notes: A3 change C14: the per-IP limit of 20,000 blocked 26 % of the peak because a whole campus shares one NAT IP. Limits are now per student token.

data.label: CloudFront distribution (HTTPS, 2 origins)
data.notes: Default behaviour -> S3 web bucket (cached SPA, OAC). /api/* -> API Gateway (no cache, auth header forwarded).

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-admin (no VPC)
data.notes: /api/admin/* - manages Cognito users and groups. Outside the VPC because it never touches the database.

customConfig.lifecycle: IA 30 d -> Glacier IR 180 d -> Deep Archive 365 d -> delete 1825 d

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-notify (no VPC)
data.notes: Sends emails through SES. Outside the VPC (no DB access); max concurrency 5 to stay under the SES send rate.

data.label: exam-platform-a3-prod-plan (AWS Backup: daily 35 d, monthly 5 y)

customConfig.note: RDS snapshots cannot move to cold storage, so 5-year monthlies stay warm (C11)

data.label: CloudWatch: 30-day logs, dashboard (load-test rows) & 14 alarms
data.notes: A3 C6: log retention 90 -> 30 days. C7: dashboard rows for Lambda throttles/concurrency/p95 and RDS connections/memory/CPU credits/proxy borrow latency.
